heroImageAlt: A man in a purple shirt sitting with a row of children in purple and red uniforms on benches under trees.
body: The White Heart Initiative is a mentorship platform focused on building self-esteem, self-care, and self-awareness in children, helping them discover, develop and nurture their individual uniqueness and passions.
quote: We are big on personal development, leadership, civic education, academic excellence and healthy lifestyles in the next generation from the get go.
vision: A self-aware and intentional people built from day one!
mission: To provide positive life guidance for children.
To create awareness for early childhood care and development of children.
To give a helping hand to parents, guardians and teachers in the upbringing of children.
goal: To care for children at an early age, molding them into well-rounded individuals who understand their roles and responsibilities through civic leadership education, enhancing their uniqueness through self-awareness, building their confidence through personal development, and ensuring academic and religious excellence as well as a healthy lifestyle.
